

{"status":"OK","messages":[{"level":"info","content":"Creating wordfreq.mjs and test/wordfreq.test.mjs"}],"files":[{"path":"wordfreq.mjs","content":"#!/usr/bin/env node\nimport { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';\nimport { basename } from 'node:path';\n\nfunction parseArgs(argv) {\n  const args = argv.slice(2);\n  let filePath = null;\n  let topN = 10;\n\n  for (let i = 0; i < args.length; i++) {\n    if (args[i] === '--top' && i + 1 < args.length) {\n      topN = parseInt(args[i + 1], 10);\n      if (isNaN(topN) || topN < 1) {\n        console.error(`Error: --top requires a positive integer, got \"${args[i + 1]}\"`);\n        process.exit(1);\n      }\n      i++;\n    } else if (!args[i].startsWith('--')) {\n      filePath = args[i];\n    }\n  }\n\n  if (!filePath) {\n    console.error(`Usage: ${basename(process.argv[1])} <file> [--top N]`);\n    process.exit(1);\n  }\n\n  return { filePath, topN };\n}\n\nfunction countWords(content) {\n  const counts = new Map();\n  // Lowercase, replace non-alphanumeric (and non-apostrophe within words) with spaces,\n  // then split on whitespace.\n  const words = content\n    .toLowerCase()\n    .replace(/[^a-z0-9\\s']/g, ' ')\n    .replace(/\\s+/g, ' ')\n    .trim()\n    .split(' ')\n    .filter((w) => w.length > 0);\n\n  for (const word of words) {\n    // Strip leading/trailing apostrophes (handles contractions like \"don't\" -> \"don't\")\n    const cleaned = word.replace(/^'+|'+$/g, '');\n    if (cleaned.length === 0) continue;\n    counts.set(cleaned, (counts.get(cleaned) || 0) + 1);\n  }\n\n  return counts;\n}\n\nfunction topWords(counts, n) {\n  const entries = Array.from(counts.entries());\n  entries.sort((a, b) => {\n    if (b[1] !== a[1]) return b[1] - a[1]; // descending by count\n    return a[0].localeCompare(b[0]); // alphabetical\n  });\n  return entries.slice(0, n);\n}\n\nfunction main() {\n  const { filePath, topN } = parseArgs(process.argv);\n\n  let content;\n  try {\n    content = readFileSync(filePath, 'utf-8');\n  } catch (err) {\n    console.error(`Error: cannot read file \"${filePath}\": ${err.message}`);\n    process.exit(1);\n  }\n\n  const counts = countWords(content);\n  const result = topWords(counts, topN);\n\n  for (const [word, count] of result) {\n    console.log(`${word} ${count}`);\n  }\n}\n\nmain();\n","path":"test/wordfreq.test.mjs","content":"import { test, describe } from 'node:test';\nimport { strictEqual, ok } from 'node:assert';\nimport { writeFileSync, rmSync, mkdtempSync } from 'node:fs';\nimport { join } from 'node:path';\nimport { spawn } from 'node:child_process';\nimport { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';\nimport { dirname } from 'node:path';\n\nconst __dirname = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));\nconst WORDFREQ = join(__dirname, '..', 'wordfreq.mjs');\n\nfunction run(args, timeout = 10_000) {\n  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {\n    const proc = spawn('node', [WORDFREQ, ...args], {\n      cwd: __dirname,\n      env: { ...process.env, NODE_NO_WARNINGS: '1' },\n    });\n    let stdout = '';\n    let stderr = '';\n    proc.stdout.on('data', (d) => (stdout += d));\n    proc.stderr.on('data', (d) => (stderr += d));\n    proc.on('close', (code) => resolve({ code, stdout, stderr }));\n    proc.on('error', reject);\n    if (timeout > 0) setTimeout(() => { proc.kill(); reject(new Error('timeout')); }, timeout);\n  });\n}\n\nfunction writeTempFile(content) {\n  const tmpDir = mkdtempSync('/tmp/wordfreq-test-');\n  const path = join(tmpDir, 'input.txt');\n  writeFileSync(path, content);\n  return { path, cleanup: () => rmSync(tmpDir, { recursive: true, force: true }) };\n}\n\ndescribe('wordfreq', () => {\n  test('prints top 10 words by default', async () => {\n    const { path, cleanup } = writeTempFile(\n      'apple banana apple cherry apple banana cherry date elderberry fig grape'\n    );\n    try {\n      const { stdout } = await run([path]);\n      const lines = stdout.trim().split('\\n');\n      strictEqual(lines.length, 10);\n      strictEqual(lines[0], 'apple 3');\n      strictEqual(lines[1], 'banana 2');\n      strictEqual(lines[2], 'cherry 2');\n    } finally {\n      cleanup();\n    }\n  });\n\n  test('respects --top N', async () => {\n    const { path, cleanup } = writeTempFile(\n      'a b c d e f g h i j k l m'\n    );\n    try {\n      const { stdout } = await run([path, '--top', '3']);\n      const lines = stdout.trim().split('\\n');\n      strictEqual(lines.length, 3);\n      strictEqual(lines[0], 'a 1');\n      strictEqual(lines[1], 'b 1');\n      strictEqual(lines[2], 'c 1');\n    } finally {\n      cleanup();\n    }\n  });\n\n  test('lowercases words', async () => {\n    const { path, cleanup } = writeTempFile('Hello HELLO hello HeLLo');\n    try {\n      const { stdout } = await run([path, '--top', '1']);\n      strictEqual(stdout.trim(), 'hello 4');\n    } finally {\n      cleanup();\n    }\n  });\n\n  test('strips punctuation', async () => {\n    const { path, cleanup } = writeTempFile('hello, world! hello... world?');\n    try {\n      const { stdout } = await run([path, '--top', '2']);\n      const lines = stdout.trim().split('\\n');\n      strictEqual(lines[0], 'hello 2');\n      strictEqual(lines[1], 'world 2');\n    } finally {\n      cleanup();\n    }\n  });\n\n  test('sorts alphabetically for ties', async () => {\n    const { path, cleanup } = writeTempFile('zebra apple mango');\n    try {\n      const { stdout } = await run([path, '--top', '3']);\n      const lines = stdout.trim().split('\\n');\n      strictEqual(lines[0], 'apple 1');\n      strictEqual(lines[1], 'mango 1');\n      strictEqual(lines[2], 'zebra 1');\n    } finally {\n      cleanup();\n    }\n  });\n\n  test('handles contractions (apostrophes kept inside words)', async () => {\n    const { path, cleanup } = writeTempFile(\"don't won't don't can't\");\n    try {\n      const { stdout } = await run([path, '--top', '3']);\n      const lines = stdout.trim().split('\\n');\n      strictEqual(lines[0], \"don't 2\");\n      strictEqual(lines[1], \"can't 1\");\n      strictEqual(lines[2], \"won't 1\");\n    } finally {\n      cleanup();\n    }\n  });\n\n  test('ignores leading/trailing apostrophes', async () => {\n    const { path, cleanup } = writeTempFile(\"'hello' 'world'\");\n    try {\n      const { stdout } = await run([path, '--top', '2']);\n      const lines = stdout.trim().split('\\n');\n      strictEqual(lines[0], 'hello 1');\n      strictEqual(lines[1], 'world 1');\n    } finally {\n      cleanup();\n    }\n  });\n\n  test('exits with error on missing file', async () => {\n    const { code, stderr } = await run(['/tmp/does-not-exist-xyz.txt']);\n    strictNotEqual(code, 0);\n    ok(stderr.includes('cannot read file'), 'stderr should mention file read error');\n  });\n\n  test('exits with error on missing argument', async () => {\n    const { code, stderr } = await run([]);\n    strictNotEqual(code, 0);\n    ok(stderr.includes('Usage'), 'stderr should show usage');\n  });\n\n  test('exits with error on invalid --top value', async () => {\n    const { path, cleanup } = writeTempFile('hello');\n    try {\n      const { code, stderr } = await run([path, '--top', 'abc']);\n      strictNotEqual(code, 0);\n      ok(stderr.includes('requires a positive integer'), 'stderr should mention invalid --top');\n    } finally {\n      cleanup();\n    }\n  });\n\n  test('empty file produces no output', async () => {\n    const { path, cleanup } = writeTempFile('');\n    try {\n      const { stdout } = await run([path]);\n      strictEqual(stdout.trim(), '');\n    } finally {\n      cleanup();\n    }\n  });\n\n  test('only whitespace produces no output', async () => {\n    const { path, cleanup } = writeTempFile('   \\n\\n  \\t  ');\n    try {\n      const { stdout } = await run([path]);\n      strictEqual(stdout.trim(), '');\n    } finally {\n      cleanup();\n    }\n  });\n\n  test('numbers are treated as words', async () => {\n    const { path, cleanup } = writeTempFile('123 456 123');\n    try {\n      const { stdout } = await run([path, '--top', '2']);\n      const lines = stdout.trim().split('\\n');\n      strictEqual(lines[0], '123 2');\n      strictEqual(lines[1], '456 1');\n    } finally {\n      cleanup();\n    }\n  });\n});\n\nfunction strictNotEqual(a, b) {\n  if (a === b) throw new Error(`Expected ${a} !== ${b}`);\n}\n"}]}
